title: Server-side rollout weight snapshots and SDK recovery simulator
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Add server-side weight snapshotting for canary/A-B/gradual rollouts, plus an SDK-side recovery simulator that replays a weight-change sequence and validates idempotent application and permission checks. The goal is to make rollouts observable, recoverable, and testable by (1) capturing discrete weight snapshots tied to an immutable rollout transaction, (2) exposing an API to fetch/compare snapshots and compute diffs, and (3) adding SDK helpers to safely apply a snapshot, retry with idempotency tokens, and simulate rollbacks locally before invoking the control plane. This ticket focuses on API surface design, backend snapshot store schema, SDK helper primitives, and integration tests covering permission behavior for shadow traffic toggles.
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /rollouts/{id}/snapshot creates an immutable weight snapshot with transaction_id and returns snapshot_id and timestamp
API: GET /rollouts/{id}/snapshots returns a paginated list of snapshots; GET /snapshots/{snapshot_id} returns full snapshot and diff base reference
SDK: provide applySnapshot(snapshot_id, options) helper that uses idempotency token and verifies RBAC before committing; retries are safe and observable
SDK: include a simulateRecovery(snapshotSequence) helper that replays snapshots against a local traffic model and reports expected traffic split, token collision warnings, and rollback paths
Permission checks: shadow/blackhole toggles require rollout-write scope; fetching snapshots is read-only and allowed to rollout-read scope
Integration tests: end-to-end test that creates a rollout, posts three snapshots (initial, scaled, rollback), and validates final traffic matches last committed snapshot
Telemetry: each snapshot creation emits rollout.snapshot.created with fields {rollout_id, snapshot_id, creator, transaction_id, delta_token_count}
